newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index falls 0.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index falls 0.1 percent.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index was barely changed in the week to Friday, off just 2.5 points or 0.07 percent. The All Ordinaries fell 0.46 percent. Changes, in percent:
Mar 7 Feb 28 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.

Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said the index was barely changed with the uncertainty of direction in the broader market and bullion prices creating a mixed speculative resources market. Falls outnumbered gains by two to one.
Hardman Resources rose 1.4 cents to 7.9 cents on interest in their Mauritania oil exploration properties, while Helix Resources NL rose 63 cents to A$3.90,

"Capricorn Resources Australia NL traded 2.5 cents higher at 31.5 cents on heavy volumes after placing 6.6 million shares at 30 cents to joint venture partners Forrestania Gold N.L. and Gencor Ltd and releasing continued encouragement from the roundtop nickel prospect," Colgan said in a commentary.
Australian Kaolin NL rose 3.5 cents to 44 cents on hopes that financing will be put in place to develop their north-west Queensland Kaolin deposit, he said.
Dalrymple Resources NL was up eight cents to 49 cents and Giralia Resources NL was up 2.5 to 17.5 cents.
Among the declines was junior marine diamond producer Moonstone Diamond Corporation NL, off five cents to 28 cents. Equatorial Mining NL was down 3.5 cents to 26.5 cents,
Consolidated Gold was off four to 37 cents and Noble Resources NL also dropped four cents to 38 cents.
